verdict.rationale: Foreloop's CLI is built for scripting: it is meant to be run "from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron," and `--json` gives stable, machine-readable output on every command. Agents can also poll for approved tasks on a cadence and work them unattended, and GitHub PR checks provide some CI-adjacent automation. However, the docs describe running the agent (Claude Code or Codex) in a checkout on your own machine, and nothing shows a headless agent-execution mode for CI/CD pipelines. Missing for 10: a documented headless/non-interactive agent run mode, CI/CD pipeline integration examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), and CI-specific auth or exit-code behavior beyond API keys and JSON output.
